proposal.reason: Primary change removes CollNet as a network capability: collective-network plugin ABI/symbols, loading, proxy/transport resources, and related connect paths are deleted. Additional substantive changes remove CollNet graph construction/search/connection logic, delete CollNet device-kernel specializations, update runtime enqueue/planning patterns and channel handling to no longer schedule CollNet flows, compact built-in algorithm/timing/tuning tables to Tree/Ring/FC/PAT IDs, and require tuner-plugin v2 with versioned config parsing to prevent old algorithm-ID misselection.
